guide.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE additional fixed punch-guide/die sprite for animation assets of this oneBeat comic punch machine. Input 1 is the machine master for exact material/style. Input 2 is the isolated MOVING RAM for dimensions and location reference; do NOT render that moving ram in the output.
Square transparent canvas, same framing as inputs. The requested sprite is ONLY a compact, substantial metal PUNCH CARRIAGE / FIXED GUIDE: a little sturdy C-shaped steel bracket with pale-blue enamel outer edge, a round upper guiding sleeve and a lower steel die with brass rim, connected by a rear support cheek. It sits on the horizontal feed-mouth rail and physically supports the moving ram; not a floating decorative ring. Paper travels through the NARROW OPEN GAP between upper sleeve and lower die. This must make it visually clear that a card lies between an upper punch and lower die, while allowing moving ram to be separately overlaid. Keep front opening clear, no long beam over card.
For registration on the original 1254 square source canvas: moving ram in input 2 occupies approximately x572..681, y589..751. Build the fixed guide around that SAME center x626, with compact upper sleeve around y645, lower die center around y770, and small rail-mounted foot around y790. Leave room for ram's barrel above; sleeve must not cover all of barrel. Sprite overall bounds around x545..710, y635..810. All other pixels transparent. Do not zoom or center sprite in the canvas; it must remain a SMALL component at this original position.
Match thick hand-ink outlines, cream highlights, sparse halftone shadows, cool steel, pale blue #A9C9F2 and small brass details. No moving ram, no paper, no machine body, no lever, no front cover, no new text, no arrows, no white square or checkerboard background. Clean alpha cutout. This fixed guide will move sideways together with the punch carriage, but it never moves down when the moving ram strikes.

base.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate one production ART MASTER for the chosen "整张时间卡" time-card punch machine in the oneBeat mobile app. Use input image 1 ONLY as the chosen concept/design and input image 2 ONLY as the project's exact comic art style. This is a new isolated asset, NOT a phone UI or storyboard. Square 1:1 transparent canvas. No text, no paper, no holes progress marks, no detached extra objects.
Style: match the reference's thick irregular charcoal ink contours, hand-painted cream edge highlights, black halftone dot shadows, bold comic cel shading, light-blue enamel #A9C9F2, coral front plate #FF7056, teal grip #29B5AE, brass joint, cream accent edges. Beautiful substantial dimensional machine, not photorealistic, not a 3D render, not wireframe/flat rectangles. Delicate printed texture inside colored surfaces. The machine should feel like the chosen concept's chunky blue/coral machine.
Front-facing slightly elevated view, mostly symmetric chassis centered on canvas, a thick BLUE compact rounded chassis and wide coral-orange foreground cover, two side metal guides and a visible empty paper carriage feeding from top/back down toward a front horizontal throat. Foreground lip/cover is thick and will later occlude the lower part of a portrait paper card. Visible flat metal lower die at one fixed center punch position at the feed throat. A small raised silver upper punch ram housed in a fixed guide over that die, with a narrow exposed working aperture; no gigantic arch or overhead beam hiding future paper. Bed, clamps and front mouth are physically connected. Empty paper-support bed between side guides must be drawn, no fake paper placeholder.

An independent visible SIDE LEVER sits on the RIGHT. One brass circular pivot firmly bolted on the right machine side at the level of the throat. The substantial narrow silver lever arm extends upward from that pivot to a long rounded teal grip, a little tilted to the right in the REST/UP pose. Pivot remains stationary on the machine body. The arm is clearly attached to the pivot, no handle floating or second pivot. Internal cam is housed in the chassis; the upper punch ram is its separate moving part.
Asset layout on a 1024 x 1024 design canvas: compact machine chassis roughly x130..820, y480..900; side guides rise to roughly y330; lever pivot roughly (830,620); teal handle near x875,y270. Leave adequate transparent margin on every side, nothing cropped. All object shadows must be sparse comic halftone shadows closely attached to the object itself, no floor, room, paper background or white rectangle. Master contains a complete empty machine with raised lever and raised punch ram; future rear/front/lever/ram layers will be extracted from this SAME master. Preserve clear edges and make components separable.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate one production BLANK TIME CARD sprite for the chosen oneBeat "整张时间卡" punch machine. Input image 1 is chosen comic concept/design reference, input image 2 is project's existing time-card style reference. New isolated asset, square 1:1 canvas, genuinely transparent background.
One portrait thick cream/ivory #FFF9EE paper card, front-facing orthographic with a barely visible thin dark paper-edge on right and bottom. Width to height ratio approximately 0.58, paper bounds around x260..764 and y80..945 on a 1024 square canvas. Slightly rounded lower corners and a DISTINCT clipped top-right corner. A coral #FF7056 band across the top, about 65px tall, follows the clipped corner. Thick hand-drawn charcoal outline, light ink wear and fine warm paper fibre grain, subdued halftone only near edges. Exactly match project's colorful printed comic artwork: ink outlines, cream highlights, restrained coral/teal palette, not gouache still life, not photograph, not flat wireframe.
The ENTIRE central card face must remain calm and BLANK: no text, no letters, no numbers, no fake result, no stamps, no punch holes, no guide circles, no preprinted grid, no stars, no logo, no screws, no clamp, no hand. Both measurement holes and final result numbers will be drawn by the app later on this same card. Leave generous uninterrupted blank upper region for result text and lower region for a 4-column by 8-row actual hole field. Preserve this same coral band and clipped-corner identity throughout use. No other object, no page background, no broad cast shadow beyond a few pixels of tight comic edge shadow. Need high quality clean alpha silhouette and beautiful paper texture.
